cases.name: buffered-publish
cases.description: publish then subscribe yields buffered items

cases.name: live-subscribe
cases.description: subscribe receives items published after subscription starts

cases.name: publish-after-close
cases.description: publish after close is a no-op

cases.name: duplicate-subscribe
cases.description: subscribe rejects a second active subscriber for the same key

cases.name: onEnqueue-hooks
cases.description: onEnqueue fires for each publish when open

cases.name: onDequeue-hooks
cases.description: onDequeue fires for each consumed item

cases.name: onPublishDropped-hooks
cases.description: onPublishDropped fires when publishing to closed channel

cases.name: no-high-water-mark
cases.description: no highWaterMark configured: onOverflow never fires, buffer grows unbounded

cases.name: high-water-mark
cases.description: highWaterMark configured: onOverflow fires at configured depth without dropping items

cases.name: enqueue-rollback
cases.description: a throwing onEnqueue hook rolls the item back and a later publish wakes the waiting subscriber

cases.name: dequeue-hook-error
cases.description: a throwing onDequeue hook rejects subscribe() with HookInvocationError after the item is dequeued

cases.name: async-enqueue-hook
cases.description: an async-overridden onEnqueue hook that rejects is routed safely through HookInvoker without an unhandled rejection
